shortDescription: Install, upgrade or remove the IBM Storage Protect Backup-Archive (BA) Client on Linux and Windows hosts

options.name: force
options.description: If true, forces reinstallation even if the desired version is already present.

options.name: install_path
options.description: Target installation directory of BA Client binaries. Default on Linux is /opt/tivoli/tsm/client/ba/bin Default on Windows is C:\Program Files\IBM\TSM\baclient

options.name: package_source
options.description: Path to the BA Client installation package (e.g., tar on Linux, .exe/.msi on Windows).

options.name: start_daemon
options.description: Whether to start the BA Client daemon/service after installation.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the BA Client installation.

options.name: version
options.description: Desired version of BA Client. Required for upgrade operations.
